page.layout: One text column, running from top to bottom. Below it, after a gap, the heading CAPUT, centred in spaced capitals. Running head at the top, page number at the top right. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: nostris, id est Turrianicis, alias fuisse, & rebus ipsis, & adversariorum eruditissimo-tum testimonio, demonstravimus. Quod vero in suis illis Epiphanius ait, πᾶσαν κα-νονικὴν τάξιν, omnem canonicum ordinem contineri, id significat, non, quod velle videtur Turrianus, 85. canonum syllogen in ultima operis parte haberi, sed, ut li-quet, eum ipsum ordinem, quo canonice tunc administrabatur Ecclesia, in iis libris traditum, atque expressum fuisse. Hæc o-mnino sunt, quæ ex quatuor prioribus Christianismi seculis attulit Turrianus; ex quibus jam constare arbitror, nullum toto illo tempore scriptorem occurrere, qui testetur, quod iste defendit, fuisse vel ab Apostolis conditam, vel à Clemente Ro-mano scriptam eam canonum 85. farragi-nem, quam ipse à recentioribus Græcis acceptam nobis obtrudit.
main_text.head: CAPUT

page.notes: The Greek phrase is printed with a hyphen at the line end (κα-/νονικὴν) and is italic. Some letters in the scan are blurred, notably "eruditissimo-tum" and the Greek accents; they are copied as they appear. The heading CAPUT has no number printed.
